reference.question: A parabola has vertex \((2,-1)\) and passes through \((3,1)\). Let its equation be \(y=a(x-2)^2-1\). Find the value of \(a\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Substitute the given point

Substituting \((3,1)\) gives \(1=a(3-2)^2-1\), so \(a=2\).
